title: Studio Automations: with the right panel hidden, selecting a node shows its configuration nowhere — the config drawer only reopens on mobile
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, reproduced, landing site named.
Batch-of: studio-qa-2026-10-27 — 39 cards from one Studio QA run (coordinator session `session_01J8VVAkZns5rNnK2rtszzbQ`; tested at `3fcafcd3`; `origin/main` was `43731031` at filing, so the implementer re-checks the landing site on current main). The run record is the `qa-run` issue filed with this batch.

## Symptom

A builder who folds the right panel cannot edit the selected step at all until they find the toggle again.

## Reproduction

1. Viewport 900×850 → `/_console/studio/<pkg>/automations?surface=flow:<name>` → "Hide the right panel" → click a node → no config drawer, no aside.

## Expected

Selecting a node with the panel folded opens the config drawer (or unfolds the panel).

## Suspected landing site (the implementer verifies)

`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` ~8157 `configFolded && !inSlot`; `showSlotProps` (~1810) reopens only when `isMobile`.

## Filing facts

- reach: Studio UI, measured by the Automations QA card.
- Business reason: The flow editor's main editing surface becomes unreachable on mid-size screens.
- Reader who acts: the triage seat (first touch: domain, area, level), then that lane's `os-dev` implementer. QA suggestion only: `domain:ui`, `area:workflow`, p3.
- Dedupe: semantic search `Automations config drawer unreachable when right panel hidden` on objectstack-ai/objectstack → 1 hit (closed #21575, read-only inspector — different).
- QA id: U9
